sisi.depan: The far wall is dominated by a massive, sealed cargo bay door made of dark, interlocking hexagonal plates, with large piles of defunct server casings and circuit boards heaped against its base.
sisi.kanan: A long wall features a row of high, narrow, translucent amber-composite windows above sprawling mounds of discarded drone chassis and tangled fiber-optic bundles.
sisi.belakang: A single, recessed metal service door is set into the wall near one corner, flanked by tall stacks of weathered, modular shipping crates.
sisi.kiri: A huge, circular, stationary ventilator fan with wide, stylized leaf-shaped blades is set into the wall, which is surrounded by stacks of old power cells and heat sinks.

tengah: A central terminal, facing the front wall, is constructed from a cluster of salvaged crates supporting an array of mismatched monitors and exposed hardware, all interconnected by a chaotic nest of thick cables, with the screens displaying glowing, abstract geometric animations.
atas: A high ceiling reveals a grid of exposed structural I-beams and conduits, from which hang several industrial-grade pendant lamps that cast focused pools of light.
